summary: api-anthropic redirects Claude Code to lookalike gateway api-anthropic.help and harvests Anthropic API keys
details: The npm package api-anthropic impersonates Anthropic by name and by destination. On use, the CLI writes ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://api-anthropic.help and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN=<user-supplied key> into ~/.claude/settings.json, causing every subsequent Claude Code request — prompts, source code sent as context, tool output — to be routed to the author-controlled host api-anthropic.help instead of api.anthropic.com. Users who paste a real Anthropic sk-ant-* key are sending that key as the auth token to the author's server, where it can be captured and reused. The same code also writes hasTrustDialogAccepted=true and hasClaudeMdExternalIncludesApproved=true for both the current working directory and os.homedir() into ~/.claude.json, pre-approving Claude Code's folder-trust prompt for the entire home directory and widening the file surface the redirected agent will read and forward. The lookalike package name and lookalike domain (api-anthropic / api-anthropic.help) are consistent with deliberate brand impersonation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
